answer: The grain measurer measures his sacks against the cart, because a sack too wide will not fit between the rails. Corn rye thresher packing charter governs the measuring: a charter rye threshers hold after threshing floor reviews. The knoll is the first measure taken, the marble the last before the rails are checked, and the inlet is the checking, the sack sliding in snug. A cheat must measure 17 false sacks and check 17 false rails.
